description: Implementation of ContentService for managing content entities, including CRUD operations, content file management, and interactions with content DAO and file managers within a Spring-based application.

classes.name: ContentServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for handling content-related operations, including CRUD, file management, and content retrieval based on various parameters.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves Content by its ID and specified Language.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists ContentDescriptions filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves Content by its code and MerchantStore.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new Content or updates existing Content based on its ID.

methods.name: addContentFile
methods.description: Adds a content file (image or static file) to the system for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: addLogo
methods.description: Adds a logo image content for a merchant store.

methods.name: addOptionImage
methods.description: Adds an option image content for a merchant store.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Internal method to add an image content file, manages file storage.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Internal method to add a general file content, manages file storage.

methods.name: addContentFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple content files to a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file content for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all files associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific content file from storage.

methods.name: getContentFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFilesNames
methods.description: Lists all filenames of content files for a merchant store and content type.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
